sensory_breadth.negativePole: Optical or auditory channels dominate; the rest of the body is largely unaddressed.
sensory_breadth.positivePole: Multiple senses and full-body experience are deliberately integrated.

embodied_agency.negativePole: The user primarily receives a preauthored experience.
embodied_agency.positivePole: Bodily action, manipulation, and feedback materially change the experience.

sociality.negativePole: Use is solitary, private, or isolating.
sociality.positivePole: Use is collective, public, or meaningfully co-present.

accessibility.negativePole: Access is expensive, elite, specialized, or geographically narrow.
accessibility.positivePole: Access is affordable, legible, and broadly distributed.

openness.negativePole: Ownership, standards, and production are proprietary or centrally controlled.
openness.positivePole: Knowledge, standards, and production are open or interoperable.

institutionalization.negativePole: The practice depends on isolated inventors, temporary novelty, or fragile support.
institutionalization.positivePole: The practice has durable organizational funding, training, and infrastructure.
